Updated hourly data through afternoon will clarify peak, with model consensus showing low uncertainty for mid-60s.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices a 56% implied probability for a 12°C high temperature at Moscow's Vnukovo International Airport today, driven by the latest ECMWF and GFS ensemble forecasts from May 8 12Z runs converging on 12–13°C amid persistent overcast skies and northerly winds of 4–8 m/s ushering cool polar maritime air. Current morning observations show +11°C under thick cloud cover with light northeast breezes suppressing daytime heating, following a sharp cooldown from May 7's anomalous 28°C and May 8's 19–20°C peaks due to a shallow upper trough and 850 hPa temperatures of 5–7°C—well below early-May climatological norms of 15–17°C. Uncertainties remain in cloud thickness limiting insolation to potentially 11°C or afternoon thinning enabling boundary-layer mixing toward 13–14°C; monitor Russia's Hydrometeorological Center updates and hourly Vnukovo readings for resolution.

However, building continental high pressure signals rapid rebound toward historical May averages of 34–35°C or above, with heatwave alerts for Sindh. Key differentiators include cloudiness and wind shear; watch PMD's daily bulletin and model updates on May 9 for resolution clarity.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket closely splits between 35°C (23.5% implied probability) and 36°C (21.0%) for Jeddah's highest temperature on May 11, reflecting tight forecast model spreads amid a dominant subtropical high-pressure ridge over the Arabian Peninsula. Recent National Center for Meteorology (NCM) guidance and ECMWF/GFS ensembles project highs of 36-37°C, rebounding from 33°C observed on May 7 after thunderstorms and convective activity cooled surface temperatures. Key differentiators include Red Sea sea-breeze effects capping coastal peaks, potential residual haze or clouds delaying peak insolation, and urban heat at King Abdulaziz International Airport. Historical May averages near 37°C provide context, but current drier conditions favor slight moderation; watch NCM's daily update and tomorrow's model runs for shifts.
